commonPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational / stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone 4:3 landscape sample illustration for OHMI's Circuit Library. Unified SOFT VOXEL ART: carefully authored small beveled blocks and subtly stepped contours, crisp clean planar facets, matte toy-like materials, no outlines, no noisy texture, no photorealism, no glossy clay blobs. Consistent orthographic isometric camera: elevation 30 degrees, verticals vertical, horizontal board axes at +30 and -30 degrees; long subject axis projects from lower-left toward upper-right. Muted turquoise, warm cream, graphite, brushed silver and sensible component accent colors. Cute through proportion and clean craft, never faces or anthropomorphism. No unrelated objects, wires, plants, decoration, particles, labels, watermarks or textual headings. No fake text or invented electronic details. This is a collection asset, not an infographic or collage.
